title: The sedimentary kaolinitic clays of South Carolina [chapter 2]
citation: Lang, W.B., 1940, The sedimentary kaolinitic clays of South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Bulletin 901, map scale 1:62,500.
notes: USGS Bulletin 901 (1940), Clay investigations in the southern States; the cataloged part is chapter 2, The sedimentary kaolinitic clays of South Carolina (Lang). Packet 1 (plate 2 and pages 2-43): front matter, chapter 1 introduction (multi-state; only the South Carolina summary applies), and the start of chapter 2 (history, rubber and paper clay properties, rubber-test tables, colored clays, overburden ratio, reserves). Rubber-compound test results (tensile strength, elongation, hardness) and the Chicora pit iron analysis are clay-product tests that do not fit the schema; plate 2 (geologic map of the Aiken area) and plate 1 map faces are OCR noise and not itemized. Texas, Tennessee, Alabama, Georgia and Florida content left out. SUBSURFACE: none in this packet.
